limits: Do not extend the first allocation or add workers without recording live resource-time costs against the shared 200 USD new-compute allowance. Retained storage and transfers consume the separate reserve. No quota increase.
deadline_type: Renewable spending safeguard; the user imposed no elapsed-time deadline.

allocation_rule: Before adding workers, recompute all spending deadlines against the shared remaining compute allowance, including elapsed time.
